channel_truth_generator: PCG64(700000+channel_seed): phase uniform(-pi,pi), CFO uniform(-0.16,0.16); delay [-7,-3,4,8][channel_seed%4]. Receiver never gets these truth fields or seeds.
stress_scope: tone_interference, missing_pilots, sparse_observation, out_of_delay, aliased_cfo, no_observation are explicitly reported; no universal out-of-prior detector claim
noise_note: Complex AWGN is RMS per chip, applied after total-energy normalization. Spreading does not provide free AWGN gain at equal energy. Direct sparse reference leaves idle payload slots; repetition is the stronger equal-duration erasure-diversity control.
measurement_note: Report synchronization estimates against evaluator truth, recovered-coordinate coverage and NMSE on recovered coordinates, plus P1 positive/wrong/abstained and two negative types. Missing output is not zero NMSE.
state_evaluation: All seven slots and nuisance-role missing-truth negatives: all code seeds x first channel seed in partial_combined. Separate from subject/object headline rate.
variation_reporting: per-code and per-channel strata; within-trial queries and crossed factors are correlated, no iid confidence claim
